hooks.command: filepath="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; case "$filepath" in */lib/openapi/*|*/gen/*|*/generated/*|*.env|*.env.*|*/pnpm-lock.yaml|*/.github/*) echo 'BLOCK: This is a generated, environment, lock, or CI file — do not edit manually.' >&2; exit 1;; *) exit 0;; esac

filepath="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; case "$filepath" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.mjs|*.cjs|*.json|*.css|*.md|*.yaml|*.yml) cd "$PROJECT_ROOT" && pnpm prettier --write "$filepath" 2>/dev/null || true;; *) exit 0;; esac
